description.zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。

> 如果查询时间范围小于1小时，会返回结束时间前1小时的数据。
description.en:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

> If the query time range is less than 1 hour, the data within 1 hour before the end time is returned.

description.zh:
性能监控指标，允许一次传入多个指标进行查询，多个指标参数间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
> 更多关于性能监控指标详情，请参见[实例监控](~~186703~~)。
description.en:
The performance monitoring metrics. You can specify multiple metrics in a single request. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,).
> For more information about performance monitoring metrics, see [Instance monitoring](~~186703~~).

description.zh: 监控数据周期倍数。例如，各资源监控项的数据采集周期均默认为1分钟，若设置周期倍数为2，则表示当前资源监控项数据采集周期为2分钟。
description.en: The multiplier for the monitoring data collection period. For example, the default data collection period for each resource monitoring metric is 1 minute. If you set the period multiplier to 2, the data collection period for the current resource monitoring metric is 2 minutes.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

title.zh: 查询实例监控数据详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds describe-drds-instance-monitor --drds-instance-id drds000000000 --key cpu --start-time 1603123290000 --end-time 1603209690000 --period-multiple 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds DescribeDrdsInstanceMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000 --EndTime 1603209690000 --StartTime 1603123290000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Key cpu --PeriodMultiple 1
